text:
Tonight is our first of two North Canterbury Children's Athletics open days.  Following the children's training, is our open athletics training sessions for new and returning high school, senior and masters athletes kicking off at 6:00pm.  

Canterbury Interclub competition starts 17th October, Secondary Schools Champs on 5th December, Oceania Masters in late January, there is something for everyone.  Pop down from 6pm, introduce yourself to our coaches and check it out.

Takahe 2 Akaroa returns! - 02.10.2027

A massive thank you to Athletics Canterbury for their hard work behind the scenes to bring this event back in 2027. We're bringing the 50th edition of the NZ Road Relay championships to the iconic Canterbury course.
